trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read of alg:gs-reduce-to-hecke-nf. No constructions from the ten categories; zero spaced em-dashes in the block. VERIFIED the rewrite rules: the Hecke relation sigma_i^2 = (q - q^-1) sigma_i + 1 and the inverse rule sigma_i^-1 = sigma_i - (q - q^-1) are both correct and match the section 7a convention, and I re-derived the inverse rule independently while checking the knot-operations tables. build_atom_nf(Z=2, N=2) is indeed 4He.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: NOT A TRAP, reported separately, three items. (1) 'Worst case: exponential in n (the partition count for H_n(q))' misidentifies the quantity: dim H_n(q) = n! is what is exponential; the partition count p(n) is subexponential (p(9) = 30, as this appendix's own step-3 and step-5 blocks correctly say). (2) Step 2a cites only the braid relation for |i-j| = 1 but says it canonicalises 'commuting / braided pairs'; the commuting relation sigma_i sigma_j = sigma_j sigma_i for |i-j| >= 2 is never stated. (3) The confluence sentence rests on the relations being 'linear quadratic and mutually compatible'; the Diamond Lemma requires that the overlap ambiguities RESOLVE, which is a stronger and checkable condition than compatibility.
